messages:
zara_ml: quick update — brought up opt-13b-refit from vendor with int8/int4 kernels. ran a small sweep on two canonical flows: chat-summary and ner-extract.

sam_engineer: nice, numbers?

zara_ml: TL;DR numbers (512-token window, dedicated pool): fp16 p50/p95 85ms/210ms, cost ~ $62 / 1M tokens; int8-q4 p50/p95 68ms/180ms, cost ~ $23 / 1M; int4-q2 p50/p95 60ms/170ms, cost ~ $12 / 1M.

leo_eval: quality readouts from eval harness (batch of ~1k cases): chat-summary (ROUGE-L) fp16 78.4 → int8 77.3 (-1.1) → int4 74.6 (-3.8). ner-extract (F1) fp16 92.0 → int8 90.8 (-1.2) → int4 87.6 (-4.4). int4 shows more failures on long, multi-turn contexts.

maya_product: int4 losing ~4 points on NER is a hard no for extraction features. breakdown by prompt length?

zara_ml: short prompts (<256) int4 is close to int8 and ok for read-only summaries. >2k tokens we see degradation and hallucination uptick. int8 stable across lengths.

david_ops: any infra issues when running int4/int8 on Dedicated?

deploy-bot: deploy opt-13b-refit/int8-q4 to pool-us-west-2-a; canary at 5% (ts 1718204921).

ezra_infra: canary telemetry clean, no OOMs. KV cache usage unchanged. host CPU +6% for int4 packing.

sam_engineer: 200M tokens/month example cost: fp16 ~$12.4k, int8 ~$4.6k, int4 ~$2.4k. Big delta but must weigh quality and support cost.

maya_product: product ask — can we route lower-risk requests to int4 and keep critical NER/long summaries on fp16/int8?

zara_ml: suggest hybrid routing: rule-based on feature and prompt_len. rough rules:
```
if feature in ['low_risk_read'] and prompt_len <= 256 -> opt-13b-int4-q2
elif latency_slo <= 200 -> opt-13b-int8-q4
else -> opt-13b-fp16
```

leo_eval: add safety gates: shadow eval on 10% of int4 traffic, track ROUGE/F1 deltas and hallucination signals; auto-revert if delta > 2.5 pts on core flows.

david_ops: cap int4 to <25% initial traffic, enable token-level costing and per-model p95 dashboards.

maya_product: please draft a short GTN slide with unit-econ impact and recommended rollout plan.

zara_ml: draft bullets: int8 reduces infra cost ~63% vs fp16 for chat. int4 gives more upside but with 2–4% metric drops on core flows — recommend pilot on idempotent reads only. rollout: small canary -> 25% guarded -> 50% with eval gates -> full if stable.

growth_lead: noted, will review econ bullets and loop in growth by EOD.

sam_engineer: next steps: 1) product & growth confirm risk bands; 2) infra scale int8 pool +20%; 3) eval enable shadow checks & auto-revert; 4) ops push routing config + telemetry.

maya_product: OK. thanks team :thumbsup:

zara_ml: opening short RFC with config + attached eval plots shortly.
